thread:
sam: hey team, Sam here (joined eng-ml today). quick clarification: for the first-week checklist — who is the canonical owner for DB read-only creds, feature-flag toggles, and who signs off on pinning model versions for a demo? trying to map who-to-ask during the ramp.
jamie (People Ops): welcome @sam :tada: good Q. People Ops coordinates org-level onboarding but we rely on eng owners for infra/service perms. i can help route approvals if you list the resources.
oliver (eng-sre): eng-sre owns production DB ACLs and oncall escalation. open a #help ticket with subject "db-access: <name>" and include app/service, query patterns, and expiry. for read-only we usually approve within a day if PRD-safe. page PagerDuty if demo-blocking.
tess (platform): platform handles feature-flag and model-serving roles. for flag toggles, ping the product-owner + feature-flags team (feature-flags@redwood.ai). for pinning model versions in Dedicated, we require approval from the model-owner + platform. DM me repo and model-id and ill pre-stage the role.
zara (security): security signs off on any long-lived creds and vault policies. short-lived demo tokens can be issued via Vault with an expiry. file the access request and put "demo-temp-token" in the body. we need purpose + expiry.
sam: thanks — can you post the minimal ticket bodies i should paste for each?
oliver (eng-sre): DB ticket snippet:
```
Subject: db-access: sam
- Service: ml-training-prod (read-only)
- Queries: analytics + model-metrics (SELECT only)
- Buckets/Hosts: rds-prod-db-1
- Expiry: 2026-04-15
- Manager: Lina (eng-ml)
```
tess (platform): Feature-flag ticket snippet (paste to #help and CC feature-flags):
```
Subject: feature-flag-access: sam
- Repo: github.com/redwood/feature-toggle
- Flag: ff/new-llm-beta
- Action: enable/disable for demo environment
- Owner: product (Eva)
- Expiry: 2026-04-10
```
zara (security): Vault token request snippet:
```
Subject: vault-token-request: sam
- Resource: vault/data/demo-svc
- TTL: 8h (demo day)
- Purpose: demo access to metrics + s3 keys
- Manager: Lina (eng-ml)
```
onboard-bot: queued request (id:onb-2160004329). you will receive updates here.
sam: perfect, filing these now and DMing @tess my repo + model id. if anything is blocking the demo i will page PagerDuty and cc @jamie.
jamie (People Ops): if you need faster routing for customer-facing demos, mark the tickets "demo-priority" and ill follow up with owners. welcome aboard :wave: and ping if you want a quick intro to the teams.
